# agyn_image_pull_secret (Resource)

Manages an Agyn image pull secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agyn_organization" "example" {
  name = "example-org"
}

resource "agyn_image_pull_secret" "example" {
  organization_id = agyn_organization.example.id
  description     = "Example image pull secret."
  registry        = "registry.example.com"
  username        = "registry-user"
  password        = "registry-password"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) Organization identifier for the image pull secret.
- `registry` (String) Registry URL or hostname.
- `username` (String) Registry username.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Registry password.
- `remote_secret_provider_id` (String) Remote secret provider identifier.
- `remote_secret_reference` (String) Remote secret reference key.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the image pull secret.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import agyn_image_pull_secret.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
